title: Rule Enforcement Matrix
description: Maps Governance Rules 1-8 to their automation level, enforcement mechanism, and human review requirements. Defines enforcement actions for each rule violation scenario.

rules.name: question_state changes must pair with REVISION_HISTORY.md updates
rules.mechanism: Session-idle warning from governance-guard.js; tracked by governance_guard_engine.js
rules.enforcementAction: Flag at session close; warn if question_state changes exist without REVISION_HISTORY.md update
rules.automatedResponse: Log warning; prevent session from closing silently
rules.escalationRule: If >10 question_state changes without revision entry → escalate to Governance Admin

rules.name: ExplanationWrong[CorrectChoice] must be empty (DL-008)
rules.mechanism: Pre-write BLOCK from governance-guard.js; pre-commit detection from governance_guard_engine.js
rules.enforcementAction: Block the write/edit operation; report QID and slot letter
rules.automatedResponse: Throw BLOCKED error; prevent file write
rules.escalationRule: Any Certified DL-008 → immediate escalation to Tier 1 structural repair

rules.name: MASTER_QUESTION_REGISTRY.md is generated — never hand-edited
rules.automatedResponse: Throw BLOCKED error; direct user to npm run build-registry

rules.name: CorrectChoice changes must include recomputed/verified note
rules.mechanism: Session-idle warning from governance-guard.js; tracked by governance_guard_engine.js
rules.enforcementAction: Flag at session close; warn if CorrectChoice changes exist without recomputed note
rules.escalationRule: Any CorrectChoice change without note → escalate to Certification Reviewer

rules.name: Max 30 question objects per change-set without BLOCK-AUTHORIZED marker
rules.enforcementAction: Block writes touching >30 QuestionID/ItemID markers without authorization
rules.automatedResponse: Throw BLOCKED error; advise splitting into ≤30-item batches
rules.escalationRule: Can be overridden by BLOCK-AUTHORIZED marker in content

rules.name: Identity Validation — QuestionID uniqueness, CorrectChoice validity, Stem presence
rules.enforcementAction: Report duplicate IDs, missing stems, invalid CorrectChoice values
rules.escalationRule: Any duplicate QuestionID → escalate to Content Admin

rules.name: Certification Pool Census — only Certified items in learner delivery pool
rules.mechanism: Per-session count from governance_guard_engine.js; pre-delivery safety check (AGENTS.md §7)
rules.enforcementAction: Report Certified count; flag if it drifts from CURRENT_BASELINES.md
rules.automatedResponse: Warn on certified-count delta from baseline
rules.escalationRule: Certified count drift >0 → escalate to Governance Admin for reconciliation

rules.name: Structural Readiness — parse-gap between markers and extracted objects
rules.enforcementAction: Report parse-gap; flag any file where QuestionID count ≠ extracted object count
rules.escalationRule: Parse-gap >0 → escalate to Content Admin for structural repair

violationScoreScale.3: Medium — process violation or answer-key concern
